primary_integration: Unchanged author Maze.play: initial dose rate(start,300)*dt; step k>=1 adds rate(destination,300+5*floor(k*dt/5))*dt; exit dose zero. Do not tune conventions to match reported endpoints.
evaluation: Stored author weights, argmax over all four actions as published code; no masks, no training, no seed or checkpoint selection. Four paper routes also integrated independently.
stop_rules: Complete fixed-weight and four-route checks first. A mismatch is recorded rather than corrected by changing inputs. This run does not retrain or access the old sealed crowd scenarios.
small_cases: No Case1/Case2 gas/FER file in this repository; keep their four FED targets unresolved. Hotel data must not be mapped onto the small building.
limitations: Author public Beta is a specific release, not proven identical to final-paper training. Concentration-to-FER and FDS simulation remain upstream, not reproduced by supplied FER tables.
